title: V-8 454 ENGINE H.D. NON-ILLUSTRATED PARTS
summary: RPO LS7 454 heavy-duty V-8: list of components that are not drawn in this option section (decal, heater hoses, rear axle/hubs/stabilizer, brake lines, engine assembly, balancer, dipstick, oil, fan, water pump, manifolds, accelerator controls, heat shield, A/C compressor, generator, starter, ignition, transmission bolts, fuel tank and lines, exhaust, front sheet metal, radiator and shroud, battery, instruments). Each is marked as assembling the same as production or the same as RPO LS5 (or LT1 / M40 where stated); part numbers are in the parts list or bill of material.
notes: The following components are not illustrated in this R.P.O. See Parts List or Bill of Materials for part numbers.
See Parts List or Bill of Material for part number.
notes_internal: List sheet only: no parts or fastening.
Model box reads 19400 as printed (other LS7 sheets use 19000).
Hole punches cover 'fol' in 'following' and the 'UP' of 'UPC 7'; UPC 7 inferred from the line content (7 TRANSMISSION).
8B FUEL LINES has no ◑ or * symbol after the dash.
Title block: drawing 3965172; DR /CI, CK 5-9-69 CI, PREL 5-5-69, C/O L88-A2; K362 in margin. Revision triangles 1-5 at left all blank except the record row with sym 3.
